name: vscode-pause-on-done
description: Automatically pauses background music when an AI or script finishes a task; plays a local notification sound if nothing was playing.

pauseOnDone.enabled.description: Enable the "pause music on task completion" feature.

pauseOnDone.completionKeywords.description: Custom keywords used to detect task completion in terminal output (case-insensitive, substring match).

pauseOnDone.enableAiSignalDetection.description: Enable built-in AI/script completion signal detection, including the "word + for + duration" pattern (e.g. Claude Code / Cursor status lines like "Done for 5s", "Thought for 1m 3s", "Compacted for 12s") plus common words like done / completed / finished / success.

pauseOnDone.soundFile.description: Path to the sound file to play when no music is currently playing. Can be relative to the extension's install directory, or an absolute path.

pauseOnDone.pauseMusic.description: Whether to pause currently-playing music on task completion. If disabled, the notification sound plays instead (subject to pauseOnDone.playNotificationSound), regardless of whether music is playing — i.e. "don't pause, just ring" mode.

pauseOnDone.playNotificationSound.description: Whether to play the notification sound when there's nothing to pause (either no music is playing, or pauseOnDone.pauseMusic is disabled). If disabled, nothing happens in that case — i.e. "don't ring, just pause" mode.

pauseOnDone.ringWhenPausing.description: Whether to also play the notification sound right after pausing music that was playing (subject to pauseOnDone.playNotificationSound). If disabled, pausing happens silently instead — i.e. "pause without ringing" mode, with the notification sound reserved for when there was nothing to pause in the first place.

pauseOnDone.autoResume.description: Whether to automatically resume music the next time you send a message to Claude Code, if this tool paused it. Only affects the Claude Code hook integration — set to false to leave music paused until you resume it yourself.

pauseOnDone.cooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown period in seconds after a trigger, to avoid the same burst of terminal output triggering media control repeatedly.

pauseOnDone.autoPromptInstallDependencie.description: On first activation, if the platform's recommended media control tool is missing (macOS: nowplaying-cli / Linux: playerctl), show a notification asking whether to open a terminal and install it. Only shows a prompt — the install command only runs if you click the button.

pauseOnDone.autoPromptSetupClaudeHook.description: On first activation, if no Claude Code hook is configured yet, show a one-time notification offering to set it up. Only shows a prompt — nothing is written to ~/.claude/settings.json unless you click the button. Can also be set up later via "Pause on Done: Set Up Claude Code Hook".

pauseOnDone.debugLogRawOutput.description: Debug option: print raw terminal output (including ANSI escape codes) received by this extension to the "Pause on Done" Output channel, to help verify the actual output content when tuning keywords/regex. Recommended to leave off in normal use to avoid flooding the Output panel.
